name: google-ads-transparency-scraper
title: Google Ads Transparency Center Scraper & Ads Library API
description: Use to export ads from the Google Ads Transparency Center. Input: website domains, advertiser IDs or advertiser names, plus region and date window. Returns one row per ad: advertiser, format, first and last shown dates, image and video links. Most text ads come back as images. $1.50 per 1,000 ads.
